Select the first 1000 activity rows for IC50 assays against human single-protein target CHEMBL1293275 (Eyes absent homolog 2). Join activities to assays, target_dictionary, molecule_dictionary, and compound_structures. Filter for standard_type = 'IC50', standard_relation = '=', and pchembl_value IS NOT NULL. Return assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, and pchembl_value. Keep all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Order by molecule_chembl_id then assay_chembl_id.
